doc.name: WithBy
doc.instructions:
Use WithBy when someone asks whether a Washington mountain pass, the I-90 or SR 520 floating bridge, or Donner Pass, Echo Summit, Carson Pass, Luther Pass or Emerald Bay at Lake Tahoe is open right now, or asks for a story about a place along Washington's highways.

Passes: WithBy checks WSDOT every few minutes and gives its own verdict for each direction of Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett passes (open, chains or closed, with the time it checked), and WSDOT's own words for 12 other passes; at Lake Tahoe, Donner Pass (I-80), Echo Summit (US 50), Carson Pass (SR 88) and SR 89 over Luther Pass and at Emerald Bay, from Caltrans's chain controls. `pass_status` answers for one pass or for the I-90 or SR 520 floating bridge, `passes_now` for all the passes.

Stories: Sal, WithBy's AI-generated narrator voice, has hundreds of short stories about towns, landmarks and stretches of road, each with its text and credit. `story` answers for a named place or story, `stories_near` for a town or landmark, `stretch_stories` for a highway or stretch such as I-90 east.

`save_for_drive` adds stories to the person's next-drive list and `my_next_drive` reads it back; both need their WithBy account, and the host asks them to connect.

WithBy covers Washington's highways in depth, and gives the pass report for the passes named above; it says so when asked about anywhere else. It does not navigate or book.

tools.name: pass_status
tools.title: Pass status
tools.description: Use this when someone asks whether a mountain pass or the I-90 or SR 520 floating bridge is open, what the restrictions or chain rules are, or how long the crossing takes. Answers for Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett passes with WithBy's verdict for each direction and the crossing time against the usual, for the two bridges with their crossing times and alerts, and for 12 other passes with WSDOT's words; at Lake Tahoe, Donner Pass (I-80), Echo Summit (US 50), Carson Pass (SR 88) and SR 89 over Luther Pass and at Emerald Bay, from Caltrans's chain controls. Every answer carries the time WithBy checked and the agency's own report time. Not for navigation, bookings, or other roads and passes.

pass.description: The pass or bridge by name, e.g. "Snoqualmie Pass", "Stevens" or "SR 520 bridge"

tools.name: passes_now
tools.title: Mountain passes now
tools.description: Use this when someone asks about mountain passes in general, which passes are open, or wants the whole list: Washington's mountain passes in depth, and the passes on the roads out of it. Gives WithBy's verdict for Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett passes in one line each, then 12 other passes in WSDOT's words, seasonal closures marked, then the passes on the way out, each in its agency's words, with the time WithBy checked. Not for navigation, bookings, or other roads and passes.

tools.name: story
tools.title: Story along the road
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for a story about a place, landmark, or town along Washington's highways, or asks to hear what Sal knows about a specific location or story by id. Gives Sal's story, place and stretch, running time, and Wikipedia / source credit; Sal is WithBy's AI-generated narrator voice. Not for navigation, bookings, or places outside Washington.

story.description: The story by id (e.g. "12"), title (e.g. "Snoqualmie Falls"), or place name

tools.name: stretch_stories
tools.title: Stories on a highway stretch
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what stories Sal has along a highway or stretch of road in Washington (e.g. "SR 520 east", "I-90 west from Seattle", or stretch id "sr520-03"). Gives the stories on that stretch in driving order with their durations and total time. Not for navigation, bookings, or roads outside Washington.

stretch.description: The stretch by road and direction (e.g. "SR 520 east", "I-90 west") or stretch id (e.g. "sr520-03")

dir.description: Optional direction (north, south, east, west) if not in the stretch name

tools.name: stories_near
tools.title: Stories near a place
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what stories Sal has near a town, city, landmark, or highway in Washington (e.g. "North Bend", "Snoqualmie Falls", "I-90"). Gives up to 3 nearby stories or nearest covered towns. Not for navigation, bookings, or places outside Washington.

place.description: The town, city, landmark, or highway in Washington by name (e.g. "North Bend", "Snoqualmie Falls", "I-90")

tools.name: save_for_drive
tools.title: Save stories for my next drive
tools.description: Use this when someone wants Sal, WithBy's AI-generated narrator voice, to tell particular stories on their next drive: it adds 1 to 50 stories, by the ids the story, stretch and nearby-stories answers give, to their WithBy next-drive list, the same list as Save for my drive on withby.ai. Needs their WithBy account. Not for navigation, bookings or places outside Washington.

story_ids.description: The stories' ids, as the story, stretch and nearby-stories answers give them

annotations.title: Save stories for my next drive

tools.name: my_next_drive
tools.title: My next-drive list
tools.description: Use this when someone asks which stories they saved for their next drive, or what Sal will tell first. Lists their WithBy next-drive list in road order with each story's length. Needs their WithBy account. Not for navigation or bookings.

resources.name: pass
resources.title: Mountain pass
resources.description: A mountain pass with its verdict, crossing times, and Sal’s pass report.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card shows WithBy's verdict for the pass (open, chains or closed), overall and for each direction with the crossing time against the usual, the agency's restriction words and report time, any roadwork, a button for Sal's pass report (Sal is an AI-generated voice), and when WithBy last checked. For the I-90 or SR 520 floating bridge it shows the crossing times and WSDOT's alerts. For one of the other passes it shows its highway, any temperature or seasonal closure, the agency's words and that WithBy has no verdict for it. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: pass-list
resources.title: Mountain passes
resources.description: Mountain passes with WithBy’s verdicts and the agencies’ reports.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card lists mountain passes with each one's highway: WithBy's verdict (open, chains or closed) for Snoqualmie, Stevens, White and Blewett, the agencies' own words for the other passes, and when WithBy last checked. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: story
resources.title: Story along the road
resources.description: Sal’s story about a place, landmark, or town along Washington’s highways.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card shows Sal's story in full: its title, place and road, its picture when there is one, its text and source credit, a button to hear Sal (an AI-generated voice) tell it with its running time, and a button to save it for the person's next drive. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: stretch-playlist
resources.title: Stories along the highway
resources.description: Stories along a highway stretch in Washington in driving order with their durations.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card lists the stretch's stories in driving order, numbered, with each one's length, the number of stories and the total time. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: stories-nearby
resources.title: Stories near a place
resources.description: Sal’s stories near a town, landmark, or highway in Washington.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card shows Sal's stories near the place, nearest first, each with its kind, distance, road and length and a button to play or read it. When there are none nearby it says so and names the nearest towns Sal covers. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: saved-for-drive
resources.title: Saved for your next drive
resources.description: Saved confirmation for stories added to your next drive.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card confirms the save: the stories just added to the person's next-drive list, how many stories the list now holds, and buttons to see the whole list. When the list is full it says so. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.

resources.name: next-drive-list
resources.title: Your next-drive list
resources.description: Your saved stories in road order for your next drive.

_meta.openai/widgetDescription: The card lists the person's next-drive stories in road order, numbered, with each one's road and length and how many there are, or says the list is empty. It is already on screen: don't repeat or list what it shows; reply in one or two short sentences with only what the card doesn't show.
